def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    lines = []
    with open('data/astronomy/input/omni2_low_res/omni2.text', 'r') as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            lines.append({'lineno': i, 'line': line.rstrip()})
    df = pd.DataFrame(lines)
    return df[(df['lineno'] >= 130) & (df['lineno'] <= 175)]
